title: Lead Gen AI Engineer - Vice President
description:
**Job Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Generative AI Developer to help drive the design, development, and integration of state-of-the-art Generative AI and
**agentic AI**
solutions across our enterprise Controls Technology platform. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, contribute deep technical expertise in context engineering, retrieval systems, knowledge graphs, and multi-agent orchestration, and play a key role in delivering scalable, grounded AI solutions to enhance automation and operational efficiency. This role centers on architecting robust applications and agent systems on top of pre-trained and hosted foundation models — not on training or fine-tuning models.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Collaborate with AI architects, leads, and stakeholders to design and implement generative and agentic AI solutions that address business challenges.
* Architect advanced context engineering strategies — context layering, chaining, compression, pruning/offloading, and memory management — to maximize reliability, provenance, and token efficiency in production.
* Design and implement advanced generative AI methods, including sophisticated prompt engineering and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Build and optimize RAG systems, including hybrid search, multi-vector retrieval, and re-ranking pipelines.
* Design and implement knowledge graphs and Graph RAG architectures to enable multi-hop reasoning, explainability, and traceable, grounded responses for high-value business domains.
* Architect agentic workflows and multi-agent systems using Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) and comparable frameworks (LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework, CrewAI), applying orchestration patterns such as supervisor/worker, hierarchical, and peer-to-peer.
* Design robust agent harnesses — governance, constraints, feedback loops, state/session management, and execution controls that make long-running agent systems reliable and safe.
* Integrate agents with tools and data via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and orchestrate inter-agent collaboration and task delegation via the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol.
* Support the integration of GenAI and agentic applications into production environments, ensuring robust deployment, scalability, observability, and maintainability.
* Contribute to the development and optimization of real-time and streaming AI solutions.
* Stay current with the latest advances in generative and agentic AI and actively share knowledge with the team.
* Ensure adherence to ethical AI guidelines, guardrails, agent isolation/sandboxing, data privacy, and compliance standards.
* Mentor junior team members, provide code reviews, and foster a culture of technical excellence.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Deep, hands-on expertise in core generative AI concepts — foundation models, LLMs, embeddings, tokenization, and context-window management.
* Advanced skills in prompt engineering and context engineering, including familiarity with prompt design tools/frameworks and dynamic context orchestration.
* Strong experience building RAG systems, including chunking strategies, hybrid search, and multi-vector retrieval.
* Practical experience designing knowledge graphs and Graph RAG pipelines (e.g., using graph databases such as Neo4j or ArangoDB) for relationship-aware, multi-hop retrieval.
* Proven experience building agentic AI systems with Google ADK and/or comparable frameworks (LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK), including tool/function calling, planning, and memory.
* Strong grasp of multi-agent orchestration patterns (supervisor/worker, hierarchical, peer-to-peer) and harness engineering (governance, feedback loops, execution controls, agent isolation/sandboxing).
* Hands-on experience with agent interoperability protocols — the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for tool/data access and the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol for inter-agent collaboration.
* Experience with agent observability and evaluation (e.g., tracing, OpenTelemetry-based tooling) for production agent systems.
* Proficiency with major GenAI APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, etc.) and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain and LlamaIndex.
* Strong skills in NLP (NER, dependency parsing, text classification, topic modeling).
* Proficiency with vector databases and embedding models for large-scale retrieval.
* Experience with containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines for AI/agentic applications.
* Solid understanding of AI compliance, guardrails, and responsible AI practices.
* Strong skills in Python and experience with data preprocessing, document ingestion, and API development.

**Required Soft Skills**

* Strong collaboration skills to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
* Analytical and proactive approach to problem-solving.
* Clear communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Eagerness to learn, innovate, and mentor less experienced developers.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or a related field.
* 5–7 years of experience in AI/software development, including significant experience in Generative AI and agentic AI.
* Demonstrated portfolio of successful AI-driven projects in a business environment.
* Experience working with AWS (or equivalent) cloud infrastructure for AI/GenAI.

description:

Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
  
  
We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
**Data Platform Engineer – Enterprise Common Data Model / Common Data Layer (CDM/CDL)**
**Pune / Bangalore / Noida, India**
**Position Summary**
As a
**Senior Data Platform Engineer – Enterprise Common Data Model/Common Data Layer (CDM/CDL)**
, you will design, develop, and deliver scalable data management solutions that power Rockwell Automation's Enterprise Data Platform. You will report to the
**Technical Leader – CDM/CDL**
and work in a hybrid capacity.
  
  
You will collaborate with technical leads, analysts, architects, integration teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to build and evolve enterprise data products, canonical data models, and scalable data services that enable trusted, reusable, and governed data across the organization.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain relational and canonical data models using Azure SQL Database, including tables, views, stored procedures, functions, keys, constraints, and indexes.
* Develop high-quality, performant T-SQL code and optimize database performance through query tuning, indexing strategies, dependency analysis, and controlled schema management.
* Design, build, test, and maintain data acquisition, integration, and transformation pipelines using Microsoft Azure PaaS services and DevOps methodologies.
* Architect data structures and pipelines that enable "Data as a Service" capabilities across business units while ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and performance.
* Collaborate with integration teams to define data contracts, database interfaces, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Contribute to the evolution of the CDM/CDL platform using technologies such as Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Integration Services.
* Manage CI/CD pipelines, release processes, and deployment automation using Azure DevOps and Git-based workflows.
* Support containerization and cloud deployment practices that enable scalable and resilient platform operations.
* Work closely with analysts, product owners, architects, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver high-quality enterprise data solutions.
* Support data governance, data quality, metadata management, and enterprise architecture initiatives.

**The Essentials – You Will Have**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience.
* 8+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, Software Engineering, or related disciplines.
* Strong experience in Azure SQL Database, SQL Server, T-SQL programming, relational database design, and data modeling.
* Experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale data integration and transformation solutions.
* Experience across the full software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile delivery methodologies.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation.
* Strong understanding of database performance tuning, schema versioning, and platform engineering best practices.
* Ability to make architectural trade-offs and deliver scalable solutions that meet evolving business needs.

**The Preferred – You Might Also Have**

* Experience with modern Azure data platform technologies including Azure Databricks, Delta Lake, Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Azure Data Factory (ADF), Microsoft Fabric, and Azure Integration Services.
* Experience building enterprise common data models, canonical data models, or master data solutions.
* Experience working with business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions.
* Familiarity with Data as a Service (DaaS), data governance, data quality, and metadata management practices.
* Experience with containerization and cloud-native deployment architectures.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts.
* Experience working in a global enterprise environment with cross-functional teams.
* Exposure to enterprise architecture frameworks and large-scale platform modernization initiatives.

**What We Offer**
Our benefits package includes:
  
  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programmed with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time Off available after 6 months of employment
* Company volunteer and donation matching programme
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalised wellbeing programmed through our OnTrack programmed
* On-demand digital course library for professional development
* ... and other local benefits!

At Rockwell Automation, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.
  
  
Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

title: Supply Chain Analyst
description:
**Life tastes better with ice cream**
With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.
  
  
We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.
  
  
**What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.**
We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.
  
  
We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.
  
  
The role
  
  
As a Finance Junior Manager gives support to the (alternatively) Materials / Factory / Logistics / Supply Chain Overheads and Business Waste respective teams by performing various day to day operational activities for them, discussing, and sharing relevant information and assumptions behind these activities so that European finance teams and countries can concentrate on their core business partnering tasks.
  
  
What you'll be responsible for
  
  
Ensure Knowledge transfer is OTIF from old SCFS Teams in Unilever ahead of the end of the TSA (Temporary Service Agreement) by end 2026.
  
  
Act as first point of contact for the respective Cost Bucket Owners in Europe and all its countries and factories covering localization process of Opus Design (New SAP) representing EU processes,
  
  
Being the linking pin between the internal Cost Buckets Owners and the team members in charge of transfer pricing and intercompany flows
  
  
Coordinate the Business Plan & Quarterly TP update processes between GBS team and 3rd party subcontractors where applicable
  
  
Facilitate the Transfer Price corrections and strengthen the controls process identifying together with Unilever SCFS the root causes
  
  
Deliver understanding & transparency of Supply Chain cost developments (Actuals vs. Forecast) for the Cost Bucket in scope
  
  
Maintain and develop various TP reporting using relevant tools (Power BI, Power Query etc.)
  
  
Lead projects for further development of the analytical support provided to the external stakeholders
  
  
Lead projects for continuous improvement in team processes
  
  
We're looking for someone who
  
  
University degree in Finance (minimum Bachelor)
  
  
Minimum of 4 years of finance working experience preferably in finance business partnering
  
  
Excellent MS Excel Skills. Power BI/ Power Query is required.
  
  
Effective Communication: Fluent in English, oral and written.
  
  
Analytical thinking, problem solving attitude.
  
  
Financial Accounting and Reporting knowledge
  
  
Effective Prioritization and Problem-solving attitude
  
  
Forward looking approach and ability to provide “what if” analysis
  
  
Multiple Stakeholders Management
  
  
IT skills – excellent level of computer literacy (incl excel & SAP)
  
  
Motivation to build up own agenda
  
  
Team working – demonstrate commitment to the team in helping to achieve goals; proactively share best practice, ideas and insights with colleagues
  
  
Agility and ability to adjust quickly to the changes
  
  
What you'll get
  
  
Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes
  
  
Market-competitive pay and performance related rewards
  
  
Flexible ways of working
  
  
Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work
  
  
Time off to rest and recharge
  
  
Ongoing learning and development opportunities
  
  
Specific benefits vary by location
  
  
**Why join us?**
This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
  
  
You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
  
  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.
  
  
**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**
If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.
  
  
**Additional Information**
The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS | PRINCIPAL DATA SCIENTIST**
**Oil & Gas | Senior Manager**
**Job Title Principal Data Scientist – Senior Manager**
**Experience Level 15+ Years**
**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Principal Data Scientist to solve complex modelling problems across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas. You will formulate operational challenges, establish defensible scientific approaches, develop critical modelling components, and define the evidence required for reliable deployment across wells, fields, equipment, process units, and sites.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include**
:
  
  
**Scientific formulation and advanced modelling**

* Formulate operational problems as predictive, diagnostic, causal, or prescriptive tasks, defining targets, objective functions, constraints, decision variables, acceptance criteria, and evaluation methods.
* Assess data sufficiency, measurement quality, sampling bias, confounding, identifiability, and operating coverage to determine whether available evidence supports the intended outcome.
* Select statistical, machine learning, simulation, or hybrid approaches suited to noisy measurements, heterogeneous assets, sparse labels, rare events, censored histories, and distribution shifts.
* Apply probabilistic or hierarchical modelling, uncertainty quantification, survival analysis, semi-supervised learning, transfer learning, or domain adaptation where appropriate.
* Develop methods for multivariate forecasting, state estimation, change detection, degradation modelling, and industrial time-series analysis while distinguishing process dynamics from measurement artefacts.
* Combine learned models with engineering equations, mass and energy balances, simulation outputs, or physical constraints, evaluating accuracy, plausibility, extrapolation behaviour, and uncertainty propagation.
* Connect predictions with constrained optimization, assessing feasibility, sensitivity, robustness, and decision quality under uncertainty; design experiments or causal analyses when observational evidence is insufficient.

**Upstream applications**

* Define modelling approaches for production forecasting, well surveillance, artificial-lift performance, drilling analytics, and production-system optimization.
* Separate the effects of reservoir behaviour, operating constraints, equipment condition, interventions, formation changes, and operating practices when interpreting performance.
* Collaborate with reservoir engineers and geoscientists on property prediction, uncertainty analysis, and simulation-assisted modelling.
* Determine whether models can transfer between wells or fields and define the data, recalibration, adaptation, and validation required.

**Downstream applications**

* Define modelling approaches for product-quality prediction, yield modelling, equipment degradation, blending, and process or energy optimization.
* Account for feedstock composition, throughput, catalyst age, equipment condition, process configuration, and control-system behaviour.
* Combine data-driven methods with engineering relationships, process simulations, and mass and energy balances.
* Connect predictive models with operating, planning, blending, or optimization workflows within defined physical and operational constraints, validating across feedstock changes, campaigns, grades, and configurations.

**Model assurance and generalization**

* Establish standards for baselining, benchmarking, feature-ablation studies, calibration, sensitivity analysis, robustness, and out-of-distribution evaluation.
* Challenge apparent improvements caused by leakage, weak baselines, inappropriate metrics, selective testing, or inadequate engineering interpretation.
* Distinguish models that reproduce historical associations from models capable of evaluating proposed operating changes.
* Define applicability limits, uncertainty treatment, monitoring requirements, fallback behaviour, and recalibration or retraining criteria.
* Assess predictive performance separately from recommendation feasibility and quality, and establish adaptation and validation strategies across assets, sites, configurations, and operating regimes.

**Technical leadership and scalable delivery**

* Remain hands-on in experiments, model development, prototyping, and troubleshooting.
* Resolve failures across data preparation, measurement quality, engineering assumptions, model formulation, software implementation, and production behaviour.
* Develop reusable modelling components, adaptation strategies, technical standards, and reference implementations; design reproducible experiments whose conclusions can be reviewed and defended.
* Evaluate emerging techniques through controlled comparisons with established methods and review production implementations for consistency with the intended scientific approach.
* Conduct scientific reviews, challenge modelling decisions, mentor Lead Data Scientists, and collaborate with engineering, data, ML engineering, and product teams to integrate validated models into operational workflows.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A degree in a relevant engineering, scientific, or quantitative discipline.
* Substantial hands-on experience developing and deploying Oil & Gas analytical solutions.
* Deep expertise in at least one upstream or downstream area, with working knowledge across both segments.
* Advanced expertise in at least one relevant applied modelling specialization.
* Strong foundations in statistics, machine learning, mathematical modelling, industrial time series, scientific computing, experimental design, and uncertainty assessment.
* Strong Python and SQL skills, including scientific prototyping, implementation of critical modelling components, and review of production code.
* Experience integrating engineering knowledge into model formulation and validation, together with reproducible experimentation, production ML, model generalization, and deployment across varied operating conditions.
* Evidence of personally resolving a difficult methodological problem and establishing an approach adopted by others.
* Experience conducting technical reviews and guiding multidisciplinary data science teams.
* Ability to defend technical decisions using quantitative evidence and clearly communicate assumptions, trade-offs, limitations, and operational implications.

**Good to Have**

* Delivery experience across both upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A master’s degree, PhD, or relevant applied research experience.
* Expertise in system identification, robust optimization, physics-informed learning, simulation surrogates, or uncertainty propagation.
* Experience with distributed scientific computing, scalable inference, cloud ML platforms, and production MLOps.
* Experience combining validated numerical models with knowledge graphs, specialized language models, or agentic decision-support workflows.
* Publications, patents, open-source contributions, or reusable technical assets demonstrating applied scientific contribution.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact modelling and decision-support challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations.
* A role with hands-on technical authority, scientific leadership, and the opportunity to establish reusable methods and standards for multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data science, ML engineering, product, and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem, and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A hands-on technical authority who can explain a difficult Oil & Gas problem they personally solved, why established approaches were insufficient, how the alternative was formulated and validated, where it can and cannot generalize, and how the resulting approach enabled other data scientists to deliver reliable solutions.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Context**

Our team is very hands-on with a strong mindset of problem-solving while also having the ability to think holistically and provide solutions that solve the customer's long-term challenges. The Data Intelligence division within this team focuses specifically on the pillars of system integrations, advanced Power BI reporting, and end-to-end spend management data solutions.
  
  
**Role**
We are seeking a highly technical, hands‑on, and detail‑oriented Principal Integration professional to lead the
**most complex, hands‑on integration designs and builds**
across our implementation portfolio. The ideal candidate is a senior individual contributor with a strong integration background and a proven track record of designing, implementing, and optimizing mission‑critical interfaces between cloud platforms and enterprise systems.
  
  
You will act as the go‑to integration expert across projects: owning design, build, troubleshooting and optimization for the most critical and technically ambiguous data flows, while setting standards that Senior Integration Leads and project teams execute against, and mentoring other team members (without direct line management).
  
  
This role is an individual contributor position, with significant autonomy and impact.
  
  
**What You Will Do With Us**
**Integration Design & Implementation**

* End‑to‑End Integration Design: Lead the detailed design of the most complex integrations between Ivalua and ERPs, HR, finance, logistics, and other third‑party systems, ensuring scalability, security, and maintainability.
* Hands‑On Build: Configure and develop integrations using Ivalua tools, APIs, ETL/EAI/middleware, file‑based interfaces and scripting where needed. Own technical implementation from design through deployment for the highest‑complexity streams.
* Standards & Reuse: Define, publish, and continuously refine integration standards, reusable patterns, and best practices (e.g., modular mappings, error handling, logging, versioning) for Senior Integration Leads and consultants to apply across projects.
* Performance & Robustness: Analyze and optimize integration performance (throughput, latency, data volumes), and design robust error handling, reconciliation and recovery strategies that serve as the reference approach for the broader team.
* Troubleshooting & Debugging: Act as the top‑level technical escalation point for integration‑related incidents that Senior Integration Leads and project teams cannot resolve, during build, SIT/UAT, go‑live and hypercare phases.

**Cross‑Functional Collaboration**

* Work with Functional & Technical Teams: Collaborate closely with Functional Consultants, Solution Architects, Data Engineers and Project Managers to align integration design with business processes and data models.
* Customer Technical Workshops: Lead or co‑lead technical workshops with customers' IT and integration teams on the most strategically significant or technically ambiguous engagements, to capture integration requirements, present solution options, and validate technical designs.
* R&D Feedback: Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams on integration capabilities, feature gaps, and improvement opportunities encountered across the portfolio.
* Pre‑Sales Support: Provide technical input on the most complex or high‑risk proposals — contributing to solution design, effort estimation, and technical due diligence for prospective clients where deep integration expertise is needed to de‑risk the deal.

**Delivery Excellence**

* Technical Specifications: Produce high‑quality, reference‑standard technical design documents (integration specification, mapping documents, sequence diagrams) and keep them up to date.
* Quality Assurance: Define the org's unit, integration, and regression testing standards and frameworks, and perform peer reviews of integration designs and implementations across projects.
* Risk & Issue Management: Identify systemic integration risks (e.g., recurring dependencies, data quality patterns, performance constraints) and partner with project teams to define and drive mitigation plans at the practice level.
* Lifecycle Support: Support cutover planning, go‑live readiness, and post‑go‑live stabilization from an integration standpoint, including monitoring and early‑life support for the most critical engagements.

**Partner & Internal Enablement**

* Technical Mentor: Informally mentor and coach Senior Integration Leads and junior integration/technical consultants by sharing best practices, code samples, troubleshooting techniques and design approaches.
* Partner Guidance: Provide technical guidance to partners' integration consultants on specific projects, clarifying Ivalua integration patterns, constraints and recommended approaches.
* Knowledge Assets: Contribute to internal knowledge base articles, how‑to guides, reference implementations, and sample configurations to accelerate future projects.

**YOUR PROFILE**
If you have the below experience and strengths this role could be for you:
  
  
**Required Skills**

* Minimum 10 years of experience in technical integration, technical consulting, or web‑based software development, ideally in SaaS or complex enterprise environments.
* Significant hands‑on experience designing and implementing integrations using ETL/EAI or other integration/middleware technologies.
* Strong practical experience with SOAP and REST APIs, including API consumption, design principles, authentication methods, and error handling.
* Solid understanding of data transfer mechanisms (e.g., SFTP, FTPS, API‑based, file‑based) and data formats such as CSV, XML, JSON (experience with cXML/EDI a plus).
* Proficient with relational databases and SQL (e.g., SQL Server or equivalent): able to write and tune complex queries, perform data analysis, and investigate performance issues.

* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with attention to data integrity, security and long‑term maintainability.
* Excellent communication skills, capable of explaining technical topics to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders, and leading technical working sessions with senior client and internal stakeholders. .

* Marketing spends

title: Interface Designer
description:
Join us as an Interface Designer at Barclays, where you will define and document integration requirements and interface specifications between BDAP and its upstream, downstream and vendor applications. You will work across business, architecture, engineering and testing teams to translate payment journeys into clear, implementable and testable interface contracts aligned with Barclays architecture, security, resilience, data and API standards.
  
  
To be successful as an Interface Designer, you should have experience with:
  
  
  

* Business or integration analysis within payments or financial services, including a strong understanding of payment-processing journeys and ISO 20022 messages.
* Defining API, event and message contracts, including XML and JSON structures, field-level data mappings, request-response models and asynchronous interactions.
* Producing Interface Requirement Documents, Interface Design Documents, sequence diagrams and end-to-end integration flows.
* Translating business requirements into build-ready user stories, acceptance criteria and interface specifications that support engineering, testing and operational readiness.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Experience defining integration behaviours such as identifiers, correlation, idempotency, versioning, compatibility, timeouts, retries, replay and failure recovery.
* Understanding of synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven and messaging integration patterns, including dead-letter and poison-message handling.
* Experience facilitating cross-application design workshops and agreeing interface patterns, responsibilities and ownership boundaries across internal teams and external vendors.
* Knowledge of security, resilience, observability, contract testing, change management and architecture-governance requirements for enterprise integrations.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in the role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
The role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
* Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
* Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
* Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
* Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
* Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
